title: Kernel-checked constraints from DESI DR2 BAO in Lean 4: certified exclusions of Omega_m bands and of H0 >= 73 km/s/Mpc with a BBN prior
description:
Two standard cosmological statements are turned into theorems checked by the Lean 4 kernel, with solvers and minimisers kept outside the trusted base. Model and inputs: flat ΛCDM with radiation neglected, the Gaussian DESI DR2 BAO likelihood (arXiv:2503.14738) and, for the second result, the BBN prior ωb = 0.02218 ± 0.00055 (DESI DR2 eq. 14, from Schöneberg 2024) with the Aubourg et al. (2015) fitting formula for the sound horizon.

(i) The BAO χ2 exceeds 35.2897 for every Ωm in [0, 0.255] ∪ [0.35, 1] and every h rd, while it is at most 10.2897 at a specific point: these bands are excluded at Δχ2 > 25 with h rd profiled (5σ for one parameter of interest; about 4.6σ if read as a joint two-parameter region). Einstein–de Sitter has χ2 ≥ 1415.82 at every h rd. The preregistered slab layout for (i) failed (8 of 19 slabs excluded); a disclosed post-hoc bisection gives the stated bands.

(ii) The combined BAO+BBN χ2 exceeds 10.2897 + 25 for every Ωm in [0, 1], every ωb and every h ≥ 0.73, and is at most 10.2897 at h = 0.6859: a certified form of the known tension between BAO+BBN and H0 ≈ 73 (conservative; independent floating numerics place the Δχ2 = 25 crossing near H0 ≈ 71.6).

Methods: a rational interval evaluator with a soundness theorem, a centred profile over the BAO scale, monotonicity in the parameters, certified log/exp/power bounds from Mathlib series estimates, integer certificates closed by decide +kernel; only the axioms propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. Both results were re-verified in independent verification runs (separate instances of the same AI model without access to the producer's build outputs: fresh rebuilds, own negative controls, independent numerics); no human has independently re-derived them. These are certified versions of numerically known results; no new physics. Preregistration, code, numerics, verification runs and drafting were performed by the AI model Claude (Anthropic) under the author's high-level direction; the author is responsible for the content.
